routes.name: Work residence visa (nulla ostra per lavoro)
routes.summary: An entry visa for paid employment in Italy. Your employer usually obtains a nulla ostra first; annual quota rules may apply and current numbers are not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: Your employer holds a nulla ostra for your role (quota rules not yet verified)
You have a job offer or employment contract in Italy
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
You have health insurance cover for Italy
No language level is listed because it has not been verified yet - check the official site

routes.name: Student visa (visto per studio)
routes.summary: An entry visa for enrolment at an Italian university or institution. Language requirement for your course is not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: You have an admission or enrolment letter from an Italian institution
You can show you can cover your living costs (amount not yet verified)
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
You have health insurance cover for Italy

routes.name: Family reunification visa
routes.summary: An entry visa to join a family member who is legally resident in Italy. Requirements are not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: A family member residing in Italy sponsors your application
You provide proof of the family relationship (document rules not yet verified)
Housing conditions for the sponsor apply (details not yet verified)
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
